about: The voice-over of the MitraClip video (video/chapters.js mitraclip-vo). tools/voice/vo.py speaks each line and times its words into video/vo/mitraclip.js. In a line, [shown|spoken] gives the caption's words and the words the voice says for them. s: the step position (src/ch/mitraclip.js, 0 to 7) at the start and at the end of the line; the device moves between them while the line plays, and holds between lines. refs: the sources of each line, keys of src/refs.js.
title: [MitraClip|Mitra Clip]: edge-to-edge repair of the mitral valve, step by step on [TEE|T E E].

lines.text: This patient has severe primary mitral regurgitation from a flail [P2|P two] scallop.
In [systole|sistalee], the free edge of [P2|P two] moves up into the left atrium, and the jet runs along the anterior wall of the atrium.
The surgical risk is high, so the heart team plans a MitraClip.
From the femoral vein, the transseptal sheath comes up to the right atrium, and its needle tents the fossa [ovalis|ovaylis].
The bicaval view shows the site from top to bottom, and the short-axis view from front to back.
The [four-chamber|four chamber] view gives its height above the annulus: for a flail leaflet, about [4.5|four and a half] to [5|five] [cm|centimeters].
After the puncture, the guide crosses into the left atrium.
The clip is steered down to the valve, over the origin of the jet at [A2–P2|A two, P two].
The commissural view shows its medial-lateral position, and the long-axis view its anterior-posterior position.
Above the valve, the arms open to [180°|one hundred eighty degrees], and the clip turns until they are perpendicular to the line of [coaptation|co-aptation].
The [3D|three D] [en face|ahn fahss] view shows the turn.
In the commissural view, the aligned arms show [edge-on|edge on], as one line.
With the arms closed to about [60°|sixty degrees], the clip crosses into the left ventricle.
About [2 cm|two centimeters] below the valve, the arms open to [120°|one hundred twenty degrees].
The clip comes back up under the leaflets, and the grippers drop to hold them.
The long-axis and commissural views confirm both leaflets in the clip.
The arms close until the leaflets meet.
Two thin jets remain, one on each side of the clip: mild [MR|M R].
The mean gradient is [3.5|three point five] [mmHg|millimeters of mercury], under the target of [5|five].
The clip is released, and the delivery system and the guide come back through the septum.
Color Doppler shows a small left-to-right shunt across the iatrogenic atrial septal defect.
On [TTE|T T E], the short-axis view shows the double orifice, and the [four-chamber|four chamber] view shows mild residual [MR|M R].
A follow-up [TTE|T T E] at [6|six] months shows how the left ventricle remodels.
